mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_search_history (user_id, keyword, search_time, source, device, ip, last_search_time, search_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES ( #{history.userId}, #{history.keyword}, NOW(), #{history.source}, #{history.device}, #{history.ip}, NOW(), 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE search_count = search_count + 1, last_search_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW()
